rule: nothing on the rotor is held by a servo or friction while it spins

options.name: Radial pins out through a rim wall with holes (your idea)
options.release: pin tips stand proud of the rim; a parked pusher on the tie ring presses one in (2 N spring)
options.grow: hub about +5 mm tall (est.), dia unchanged
options.note: tip proud of the wall = 'locked' signal for a sensor

options.name: Radial pins from the centre spindle into the carrier bores
options.release: no access: the pins are buried under the blades at r 10
options.grow: 4 carrier rings 5 mm each: hub +10 mm (est.)
options.note: 15 deg holes do not fit at r 10.5 (need r 17.2)

options.name: Axial pins (parallel to the shaft) through the plates
options.note: would also carry the 826 N pull, but nothing but a spring keeps it in

options.name: Face teeth (crown ring) pressed together by a spring
options.note: teeth cam apart under side load unless the spring wins

options.name: L1 with dia 2 pins (no hub growth)
options.grow: none (rim 3.6 mm tall fits above the pull rings)

options.name: L1 plus a V-seat under each root
options.note: the finger's own 826 N pull wedges the root into a V: takes out hole play
